note: Literature establishes KLHL20 variants as causing early-onset seizures/febrile seizures alongside intellectual disability, hyperactivity, and autism spectrum disorder in a stable neurodevelopmental pattern rather than a neurodegenerative decline.

evidence.text: In a cohort of 14 individuals with de novo missense variants in KLHL20, manifestations included mild to severe intellectual disability, febrile seizures or epilepsy, autism spectrum disorder, and hyperactivity, characterizing a stable neurodevelopmental syndrome.

source.title: De novo missense variants in the E3 ubiquitin ligase adaptor KLHL20 cause a developmental disorder with intellectual disability, epilepsy, and autism spectrum disorder
source.quote: We studied 14 patients with de novo missense variants in KLHL20, delineating a genetic syndrome with patients having mild to severe intellectual disability, febrile seizures or epilepsy, autism spectrum disorder, hyperactivity, and subtle dysmorphic facial features.

evidence.text: Report of early-onset West syndrome and developmental delay linked to KLHL20 variant, confirming seizure onset in early infancy.

source.title: Early-onset West syndrome with developmental delay associated with a novel KLHL20 variant
source.quote: KLHL20 variants might be associated with earlyonset West syndrome and developmental delay.
